entries.description: Reference-preserving Klein 9B editing: improve structural consistency when the requested change is small and the existing reference layout/appearance must be retained. Avoid for changed viewpoint, four-view camera layouts, major transformations or freely recomposed scenes because stronger consistency can resist edits.
entries.preset_basis: Studio conservative trial preset 0.6, not an author numeric recommendation; author advises lowering strength if it prevents the desired edit. No documented trigger.

entries.description: Krea2 text-fusion adapter locally tested for explicitly requested NON-GRAPHIC fictional blood marks on intact objects, fabric or wardrobe. Helps restore missing visible red blood stains in photographic horror-film props. Only choose for actual requested visible blood stains, not blood-red color metaphors, generic horror mood, clean objects, or negated blood. Does not add a new style. No claim of broader anatomy or gore capability.
entries.preset_basis: Studio validated sample preset at strength 1.0, not an author numeric recommendation. Local 160-byte F32 [1,12] txtfusion.projector.diff matches published file hash. Same-seed/identical-prompt Studio sample shows visible dark-red cloth stains compared with faint marks without this adapter. This is a single-scene validation, not broad quality assurance.
